purpose: Measure whether the native fractional spike readout carries more useful QCC information than the retained native gate when the frozen source trajectories are identical.

source.models: same-seed frozen SW0097 sources 0, 1, 2, strictly mapped with the SW0135 native32 foundation
source.rgb: registered SW0135 full-resolution RGB preprocessing and encoder

trajectory.event_capture: E=act_fun_adp(component_membrane - 0.06*exp(wrapped.b[component_id])), directly reevaluating the frozen SW0134 native forward threshold equation on its saved membrane trace; never recover E by dividing S by g
trajectory.identity_guard: require torch.equal(S, E*g) for the full component trace, including positions where g is zero
trajectory.trajectory_parity: repeat the registered first TRAIN example after state reset and require exact equality of all six trace fields from frozen late_rollout
trajectory.counterfactual: replace only the QCC readout activity with retained native gate g; do not change recurrence, reset, feedback, gates, weights, geometry, or background rule

readout.implementation: frozen SW0136 QCC helper as invoked by SW0137
readout.affinity: positive-clamped product of per-component signed Pearson correlations on actual S or retained g

evaluation.target: native128 ground truth converted directly to32 by production modal/minimum-ID-tie 4x4 pooling
evaluation.prediction_freeze: all six prediction arrays, protocols, SW0137 dependency hashes and fixed IDs are verified before the first target mask is opened

paired_bootstrap.unit: resample common image indices across all three seeds

interpretation: A frozen readout attribution screen only. It does not remove membrane feedback or reset dynamics, establish gate necessity, train a gate-only candidate, or promote a model.
